autotrade.mod.name: Auto Trade
autotrade.message.no_trade: No trade available with this villager
autotrade.message.reason_item_not_in_lis: Item not in the trade list
autotrade.message.roller_need_lecterns: Need at least 3 lecterns in offhand
autotrade.message.roller_need_axe: Need an axe in main hand
autotrade.config.generic.comment.enabled: Do auto trading with villagers in range
autotrade.config.generic.comment.selectU: Select buy/sell items with item frames (max. distance 3) with items nametagged "buy" or "sell"
autotrade.config.generic.comment.selectB: Select input/output containers via item frame on the block: put a nametagged chest item ("input" / "output") in the frame (max. distance 3)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.turnHea: Turn the player's head toward the villager before interacting (some servers e.g. GrimAC check head direction, most servers don't need this)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.useBari: Use Baritone for movement (pause/resume and time waypoint walking). Disable if you move the player yourself.
autotrade.config.generic.comment.enableS: Enable selling (if disabled emeralds are taken from the input container)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.sellIte: The item to sell for emerald. Optional suffix #enc1=lv&enc2=lv (enchantment registry ids) matches exact enchantments, e.g. enchanted books.
autotrade.config.generic.comment.enableB: Enable buying (if disabled emeralds are placed in the output container)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.buyItem: The item to buy using emerald. Optional suffix #enc1=lv&enc2=lv matches exact enchantments (use set-buy hotkey with the book in hand).
autotrade.config.generic.comment.maxInpu: Stacks to take from input container (or emerald container in buy-only mode), also the max amount of input and emerald kept.
autotrade.config.generic.comment.inputCo: Input container X (not used when sell disabled)
Input container Y (not used when sell disabled)
Input container Z (not used when sell disabled)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.outputC: Output container X (not used when buy disabled)
Output container Y (not used when buy disabled)
Output container Z (not used when buy disabled)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.voidTra: Delay in ticks for void trading
autotrade.config.generic.comment.delayAf: true: Start the delay after the villager was unloaded; false: Start the delay after the trade has been initiated
autotrade.config.generic.comment.contain: Delay in ticks; to get signal from trapped chest
autotrade.config.generic.comment.interac: Maximum distance to interact with a villager (in blocks)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.removeD: Distance at which a villager is removed from the tracked range list (in blocks)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.itemFra: Maximum distance to detect item frames for buy/sell/container selection (in blocks)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.contain: Maximum distance to interact with input/output containers (default: 4 blocks)
Distance at which a container is forgotten after interaction (default: 9 blocks)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.visible: Buffer tolerance for line-of-sight checks (higher = more lenient)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.selecte: Comma-separated list of selected enchantment IDs (set via the "Select Enchantments" button on a librarian's trade screen)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.afkOnCo: Command to execute to turn AFK on (example: .toggle anti-afk on)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.afkOffC: Command to execute to turn AFK off (example: .toggle anti-afk off)
autotrade.config.generic.comment.timeWay: Time waypoints for Baritone walking. Format per entry: tick:x,y,z
autotrade.config.hotkeys.comment.setSell: Sets the item to sell from hotbar
autotrade.config.hotkeys.comment.setBuyI: Sets the item to buy from hotbar
autotrade.config.hotkeys.comment.setInpu: Sets the input (item to sell) container
autotrade.config.hotkeys.comment.setOutp: Sets the output (item to buy) container
